No Result View All Result Home News Politics Business Sport Football Health Entertainment Education Opinion Editorial Columns Others LeVogue Magazine Conferences National Economy Contact Us Hausa Edition Home News Politics Business Sport Football Health Entertainment Education Opinion Editorial Columns Others LeVogue Magazine Conferences National Economy Contact Us No Result View All Result No Result View All Result Enugu APC Strategises For Gov Mbah’s Re-election by Emmanuel Mgheahurike 7 seconds ago in News Share on WhatsApp Share on Facebook Share on X Telegram The leadership of Enugu State All Progressives Congress (APC) Campaign Council has emphasised that the framing of their message towards the second term election of Governor Peter Mbah is anchored on the quality of performance of the governor.
They party said the flawless expertise and innovative imagination which Governor Mbah brought into office, has made him a standout in sub-Sahara Africa.
The council said its strategic committee meeting was aimed to coordinate campaign activities, map out mobilisation plans and establish a framework for marketing Mbah and all candidates of the party ahead of the 2027 general elections.
The meeting, convened by the council’s director-general, Chief Charlie Mbah, brought together key members of the campaign leadership to review strategies, draw on their political experience and prepare for an effective campaign across the state.
Those in attendance included the deputy directors-general representing the three senatorial zones: Deacon Okey Ogbodo for Enugu East, Dr. Dan Shere for Enugu North and Rt. Hon. S.K.E. Udeh-Okoye for Enugu West, alongside the campaign council’s Secretary General, Dr. Eric Oluedo.
Briefing journalists after the meeting, the council’s spokesperson, Barr. Steve Oruruo, said the gathering represented the core leadership of a wider campaign structure comprising prominent politicians, former public office holders, intellectuals and influential figures from the business class and the academia.
“We have a very strong body, out of which the very core had to meet today under the chairmanship of the Director-General, the ebullient Chief Charlie Mbah, who set the tone for an effective outing in terms of marketing the governor and all other candidates of the APC from top to bottom,” Oruruo said.
